title: Identity-aware recurrent toxicity classifier
summary: The solution tokenizes lowercased comments with a regex, builds a frequency vocabulary from training text only, maps unknown tokens to one and pads or head-truncates sequences to 220 tokens. It pretrains 300-dimensional embeddings on training tokens using skip-gram negative sampling with frequent-word subsampling. A spatially dropped embedding sequence passes through a bidirectional LSTM followed by a bidirectional GRU. The classifier concatenates masked max and mean pools from both recurrent outputs with attention pooling of the GRU output, applies a residual dense ReLU/dropout block, and predicts a toxicity logit plus identity logits. Training uses mean-normalized weights that upweight identity-containing and identity/target subgroup cases. The objective is weighted binary cross-entropy for toxicity plus equally weighted auxiliary identity BCE. AdamW, mixed precision, gradient clipping, epochwise learning-rate decay, and shuffled length-bucketed batches are used. Inference sigmoid-transforms the toxicity logit and averages predictions from the final two epochs and across configured seeds.
